title: unified-rollouts: add telemetry and safety guards for canary/A-B/shadow autorollback
author: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Add structured telemetry and safety guards to the unified rollouts decision engine to improve observability of canary/A-B/shadow promotions and to reduce false-positive automated rollbacks. Motivation: Recent incidents (see SUP-1012) showed that noisy metrics and short-lived spikes caused premature autorollbacks during staged canary and shadow experiments. This change centralizes decision telemetry, adds metric quorum and debounce windows, and surfaces decision signals in the Console.

What I changed: Implemented a lightweight telemetry schema for rollout decisions, added configurable safety guards for autorollback (metric quorum, min-sample-size, debounce window), and extended the rollback engine to require multi-metric agreement by default. Also added an observability dashboard and e2e tests that simulate staged shadow probing.

Files/areas touched (high-level): rollouts/engine - decision engine instrumentation and metric aggregation; rollouts/autorollback - safety guard checks and composite metric evaluator; rollouts/telemetry - metrics registry and protobuf/JSON schema; redwood-console/dashboards - new rollback overview; rollouts/e2e - stability guards test harness; ci - presubmit matrix to exercise canary/ab/shadow paths.

Implementation notes: - Telemetry events are emitted for every rollout decision: {"decision_type":"promote|quarantine|rollback","composite_score":"float","metrics":[..],"quorum":"int"}. Events are batched and sent asynchronously to avoid adding latency to the critical path. - Safety guards: (1) metric_quorum: require N independent metrics to be above threshold before triggering rollback; (2) min_sample_size: require >M requests in the window before evaluating; (3) debounce_window: wait T seconds of sustained signal before acting. Defaults are conservative and can be tuned per-rollout via the existing rollout-config. - Backwards compat: If telemetry backend or safety flags are disabled, the engine falls back to current behavior (no autorollback changes).

Testing: Unit tests cover new guard logic and composite scoring. Integration tests validate telemetry emission to the local test sink. E2E tests simulate a staged shadow probe with synthetic latency and quality regressions to ensure the composite quorum prevents noisy single-metric rollbacks. CI: presubmit matrix added a job that runs the new e2e smoke test in the matrix.

Rollout plan: Merge to main, release a non-breaking runtime patch, enable conservative defaults globally for 48h, then opt-in customers can tune. Dashboard will be available in Console in the next deploy. If any issues are observed, we will revert via the usual rollback playbook.

Related: ENG-4210, ENG-4301, SUP-1012.

Small snippet (decision evaluation update): "if samples < min_sample_size or quorum_met < metric_quorum: return NO_ACTION" - implemented as a fast-path in the evaluator to avoid expensive scoring when data is insufficient.
commits: feat(rollouts): add telemetry for canary/ab/shadow decision engine
feat(autorollback): require metric quorum and debounce window before triggering rollback
test(e2e): add staged shadow probing harness and synthetic regressions
docs: update unified-rollouts.md and console dashboard notes
review_comments: Jordan Lee: Can we make metric_quorum tunable per-rollout? I think 3 is a sensible default but some customers may need 5 for noisy environments.
Maya Chen: Yes — added rollout-config override. Default remains 3; documented in docs/unified-rollouts.md.
Priya Natarajan: Tests look good; please add an integration test that simulates partial metric reporting (one metric missing).
Maya Chen: Added integration test and a fallback path that treats missing metrics as not-signaling so they do not count towards quorum.
Samir Patel: LGTM after CI green. Confirmed e2e smoke passed locally and in CI (flaky e2e retried once).
Elena Ruiz: Approved — good telemetry shape and low-overhead async batching.
ci_checks: perf-regression: no significant change (p95 latency delta < 1%)
merge_details: Merged by Samir Patel via squash merge. Branch was rebased onto main after CI green. Release notes drafted and added to docs. Rollout: progressive canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback governed by new composite metric quorum and debounce windows.
release_notes: Add structured telemetry for unified rollouts decision engine (canary/A-B/shadow).
Introduce safety guards for autorollback: metric_quorum, min_sample_size, debounce_window.
E2E tests for staged shadow probing and stability guards.
Console: new Rollback Overview dashboard to visualize decision signals and telemetry.
